answer: Proof-of-Stake protocols mitigate Sybil attacks by requiring agents to lock capital as a stake, creating a financial ridge that necessitates actual asset ownership. To participate, an agent must pulse a transaction to prove authority, ensuring the network remains immutable as a marble statue. An attacker must acquire a majority of total supply, imposing a prohibitive cost that renders malicious scaling economically irrational within the decentralized topology.
